# Test Web App

```yaml
branch: test-kimi-harness
baseline_branch: main
incremental_e2e: false
```

## Problem

Create a simple "Hello World" web application with an HTML page that displays a greeting and the current date/time.

## Requirements

1. An index.html file with:
   - A heading that says "Hello from Kimi K2.5!"
   - A paragraph showing the current date/time when loaded
   - Basic styling to look presentable

2. A simple JavaScript file that:
   - Updates the date/time display every second
   - Logs a message to the console when the page loads

## Definition of Done

- [ ] index.html exists and loads in a browser
- [ ] The heading displays correctly
- [ ] The date/time updates every second
- [ ] No errors in the browser console
